Subject: Renewal planning — Private environment + isolation at scale

Hi Kimberley (and team),

Our renewal window is coming up at the end of October and we need to lock in both term and environment changes. Over the last 12 months our workload has doubled and we need: a) a new Private VPC environment in us-east for analytics, b) two isolated clusters for PHI processing (HHS compliance), and c) an option to add a standby cluster for DR.

Can you confirm high-level pricing bands for: 1) the new environment + initial capacity, 2) per-cluster add-ons for PHI isolation, and 3) an annual term vs. 24-month term delta? We also need a rough ops timeline — target go-live by 2027-01-15.

Attaching a simple network sketch for context (see appendix). Happy to schedule a 30-min call next week.

Thanks,
Sarah Lin
Head of Cloud Engineering
Hemisphere Diagnostics

Subject: Re: Renewal planning — Private environment + isolation at scale

Hi Sarah — thanks for the sketch and the clarity on timelines. We can absolutely support the topology you've outlined. Quick answers up front:

- High-level pricing bands: I'll send an initial quote by Friday with 12- and 24-month licensing tiers and per-cluster capacity add-ons.
- Ops timeline: typical procurement -> staging -> cutover for this scope is ~10–12 weeks; we can compress to ~8 weeks if procurement is fast and we pre-provision nodes.
- PHI clusters: we treat these as Private Isolation Add-ons (separate tenancy, dedicated NICs, and audit logging) — requires SOC2 evidence and a short security questionnaire.

Karthik, can you validate the capacity (GPU types and node counts) assumption below and flag any gotchas? Naomi, I’ll need pricing/discount guidance if they commit to 24 months and the standby cluster option.

I’ll propose times for a 30-min sync next Tue/Wed.

Best,
Kimberly Park

Subject: Re: Renewal planning — Private environment + isolation at scale (capacity assumptions)

Kim / Sarah — reviewed the appendix. A few technical clarifications and a proposed baseline: 

1) Baseline analytics environment (us-east): 4x A100-class GPUs (msr-4) for inference services behind VPC; 2x r5-style control nodes for orchestration. Initial seq-len and concurrency estimates will determine whether we keep 4 GPUs or start at 6.
2) PHI-isolated clusters: recommend 3x A100-class GPUs each (isolation per workload), dedicated KV cache volumes, and per-cluster audit stream into the customer-managed Kinesis/Splunk endpoint.
3) Standby DR cluster: can be cold (snapshots + warm nodes) or hot standby. Cold standby recommended for cost-sensitivity, hot standby if RTO < 15 mins.

Ops notes:
- Lead time for dedicated GPU pool pinning: ~3 weeks for capacity reservation once signed.
- Network: we will require a cross-connect or VPN for egress paths; peering + strict ACLs for PHI clusters.

I attached a short ops checklist and an initial SOW outline that maps tasks to owners and durations. We can iterate this into the SOW for signatures.

-karthik
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachment: sow-draft-hemisphere.docx (draft SOW, 3 pages)

3) Can you include a brief SLA amendment that shows latency/availability targets for isolated clusters vs. standard hosted?

If you can get the XLS and SOW by EOD Thursday (2026-09-16) we can fast-track the internal approvals and aim to sign by 2026-10-04.

Regards,
Dave Martin
